integrity: Entire proof given for all d>=3; exact finite determinant checker crosschecks d=2..6 but does not prove an infinite statement; no external expert or independent review was performed.
scientific_limitations: Balanced next-to-full projected Plucker Grassmannians over C only; reduced singular support and local-completion types rather than Jacobian nonreduced scheme; no unbalanced or deeper truncations. title: Singular strata and transverse determinantal cones of balanced truncated Grassmannians
